narrativePost.fullText:
# LinkedIn Technical Marketing Post: Subscription License & Billing Leakage Detector

Reconciliation engine that audits application user seats against Stripe subscription tiers, flagging free-rider users who retained access after plan cancellations.

### The Problem
Most companies lose thousands in hidden operational waste every single month.

### The Engineered Fix
We engineered a zero-dependency system to solve this.

👉 Try the live interactive simulator here:
https://gideonbawa-website.netlify.app/simulators/subscription-leakage-detector/

#SoftwareEngineering #Automation #SystemsArchitecture #BuildInPublic
